details: The United States and Iran have agreed to a peace deal, leading to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and the lifting of a US blockade on Iran. This development has been met with a positive market reaction, with S&P 500 futures rising, the dollar falling, and crude oil futures dropping over 4%. Bitcoin also saw a recovery towards $64,000 following the de-escalation signals. Analysts anticipate that while a full return to normal oil flow may take months, the immediate risk overhang on markets has been reduced.
title: US-Iran Peace Deal Reopens Strait of Hormuz, Calms Oil Markets

details: A significant shift is underway as major cryptocurrency exchanges are transforming into multi-asset financial platforms. Platforms like OKX, Kraken, and Hyperliquid are now offering perpetual futures and tokenized markets for traditional finance assets such as tech stocks, commodities (gold, silver, crude oil), and major index funds (SPY, QQQ). This move aims to retain traders and capital on crypto platforms by providing a more comprehensive financial experience, indicating a growing convergence between crypto and Wall Street.
title: Major Crypto Exchanges Offer TradFi Assets, Blurring Market Lines
